dm.arena_text_html: Seven entered the arena. Each with his own story.
dm.fine_html:
The price is the sum of the individual prices, with no bundle discount. Only available fragrances are added.
All prices incl. VAT, plus shipping · Delivery in 1–3 working days · Free shipping within Germany.
dm.duo_sub_html: Martial · Opening of the Colosseum · AD 80
dm.spartacus_story_html: In 73 BC he escapes from the gladiator school in Capua with around 70 others. The band grows into an army that keeps Rome on edge for two years.
dm.spartacus_heart_html: Cinnamon, nutmeg, lily of the valley
dm.crixus_story_html: In 73 BC he breaks away from Spartacus with a large part of the army and falls in 72 BC at Monte Gargano, after storming a steep slope three times. Spartacus holds funeral games in his honour.
dm.commodus_story_html: An emperor who stepped into the arena himself. Cassius Dio, a contemporary witness, reports that he slew a hundred lions in a single day. In AD 192 he was strangled in his bath, not in the arena.
dm.marcus_story_html: Inspired by Crassus, the Roman who defeated Spartacus in 71 BC. Calm, clear, refined: citrus and white flowers over warm wood.
dm.marcus_heart_html: Lily of the valley, rose, white flowers
dm.rexor_story_html: Inspired by the eques, the mounted gladiator with plumed helmet and round shield. Spicy, powdery, woody: plum and pepper over cedarwood.
dm.rexor_heart_html: Pepper, lily of the valley, rose
dm.priscus_story_html: In AD 80, at the opening of the Colosseum, he fights Verus. According to Martial, the duel ends without a loser. Fresh, green, woody: apple and galbanum over cedarwood and vetiver.
dm.verus_story_html: Priscus’s opponent in the duel without a loser. Martial writes: “Equal they fought, equal they yielded.” Aromatic, smoky, woody: bergamot and eucalyptus over frankincense and vetiver.
